SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."cdscode") AS "charter_funded_schools_count"
FROM "satscores" sc
JOIN "schools" s
  ON s."cdscode" = sc."cds"
WHERE sc."avgscrmath"::NUMERIC > 560
  AND s."fundingtype" = 'Directly funded'

SELECT s.phone
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s
  ON s.cdscode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.numtsttakr > 0
ORDER BY (sat.numge1500::numeric / sat.numtsttakr) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    s."school" AS school_name,
    s."charternum" AS charter_number,
    sc."avgscrwrite" AS avg_writing_score
FROM "satscores" sc
JOIN "schools" s
    ON s."cdscode" = sc."cds"
WHERE sc."avgscrwrite"::NUMERIC > 499
  AND s."charternum" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sc."avgscrwrite"::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT s."cds", s."avgscrread"
    FROM "satscores" s
    WHERE s."avgscrread" IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY s."avgscrread"::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM "frpm" f
JOIN top_school t ON f."cdscode" = t."cds"

WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT "admfname1" AS first_name, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname1" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS first_name, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname2" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS first_name, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname3" <> ''
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT "first_name", COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY "first_name"
    ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT an."first_name", an."district"
FROM admin_names an
JOIN name_counts nc ON an."first_name" = nc."first_name"
GROUP BY an."first_name", an."district"
ORDER BY an."first_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, an."district" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.school LIKE '%Youth Authority%'
  AND s.mailstreet LIKE '%PO Box 1040%';

SELECT
    s."school" AS school_name,
    s."ncesschool" AS nces_school_id,
    f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_ages_5_17
FROM "frpm" f
JOIN "schools" s ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(s.numtsttakr::NUMERIC) AS avg_numtsttakr
FROM schools AS sc
JOIN satscores AS s
  ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
WHERE sc.city LIKE '%Fresno%'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sc.opendate) = 1980;

SELECT s."gsoffered"
FROM "schools" AS s
WHERE s."longitude" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s."longitude"::NUMERIC) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s."sname" AS school_name,
        sc."mailstreet" AS postal_street,
        s."avgscrmath"::NUMERIC AS math_avg,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s."avgscrmath"::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk
    FROM "satscores" s
    JOIN "schools" sc
        ON sc."cdscode" = s."cds"
    WHERE s."avgscrmath" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    "school_name",
    "postal_street"
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 7
ORDER BY "school_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT
    s."phone",
    s."ext"
FROM "schools" s
JOIN "satscores" sat
    ON s."cdscode" = sat."cds"
WHERE sat."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST
OFFSET 332 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT
    s."avgscrmath" AS "avgscrmath",
    s."cname" AS "cname"
FROM "satscores" s
WHERE (s."avgscrmath" + s."avgscrread" + s."avgscrwrite") IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (s."avgscrmath" + s."avgscrread" + s."avgscrwrite") ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    s.street,
    s.city,
    s.zip,
    s.state
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.cdscode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.numtsttakr IS NOT NULL
  AND sat.numtsttakr::numeric > 0
  AND sat.numge1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (sat.numge1500::numeric / sat.numtsttakr::numeric) ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    s."school" AS "school",
    sc."avgscrwrite" AS "avgscrwrite",
    s."phone" AS "phone"
FROM "schools" s
JOIN "satscores" sc
    ON s."cdscode" = sc."cds"
WHERE
    
    (s."opendate" IS NOT NULL AND s."opendate" <> '' AND s."opendate"::date > DATE '1991-12-31')
    OR
    
    (s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL AND s."closeddate" <> '' AND s."closeddate"::date < DATE '2000-01-01')
ORDER BY sc."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT
    f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0) AS "free_rate"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE (s.admfname1 LIKE '%Kacey%' AND s.admlname1 LIKE '%Gibson%')
   OR (s.admfname2 LIKE '%Kacey%' AND s.admlname2 LIKE '%Gibson%')
   OR (s.admfname3 LIKE '%Kacey%' AND s.admlname3 LIKE '%Gibson%');

WITH closed_counts AS (
    SELECT
        s."county",
        COUNT(*) AS closed_cnt
    FROM "schools" s
    WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY s."county"
    ORDER BY closed_cnt DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    s."school",
    s."closeddate"
FROM "schools" s
JOIN closed_counts cc
    ON s."county" = cc."county"
WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
ORDER BY s."closeddate" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT s."phone"
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Directly funded'
  AND s."opendate"::date > DATE '2000-01-01';

SELECT
    f."District Code",
    f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s
    ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.admfname1 LIKE '%Alusine%'
   OR s.admfname2 LIKE '%Alusine%'
   OR s.admfname3 LIKE '%Alusine%';

SELECT
    s."city",
    s."school",
    s."gsoffered" AS "lowest_grade"
FROM "schools" s
WHERE s."state" = 'CA'
  AND s."latitude" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s."latitude"::REAL ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."admemail1"
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(
               CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS NUMERIC) - CAST(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS NUMERIC)
           ) AS avg_difference
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
    WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
)

SELECT
    s.school,
    s.doctype
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
CROSS JOIN avg_diff a
WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
  AND (CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS NUMERIC) - CAST(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS NUMERIC)) > a.avg_difference

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT ss."cds", ss."sname", ss."numge1500"
    FROM "satscores" ss
    ORDER BY ss."numge1500"::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT s."admfname1", s."admlname1"
FROM "schools" s
JOIN top_school ts ON s."cdscode" = ts."cds"
WHERE s."admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND s."admlname1" IS NOT NULL

UNION

SELECT s."admfname2", s."admlname2"
FROM "schools" s
JOIN top_school ts ON s."cdscode" = ts."cds"
WHERE s."admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND s."admlname2" IS NOT NULL

UNION

SELECT s."admfname3", s."admlname3"
FROM "schools" s
JOIN top_school ts ON s."cdscode" = ts."cds"
WHERE s."admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND s."admlname3" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.county = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.charter = 0
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)") < 0.18;

SELECT
    s."city",
    COUNT(DISTINCT s."cdscode") AS school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
    ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode"
WHERE s."magnet" = 1
  AND s."gsserved" = 'K-8'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s."city"
ORDER BY s."city" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT c."artist"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."side" IS NULL
  AND c."convertedmanacost" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY c."convertedmanacost"::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."uuid") AS card_count
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."artist" LIKE '%John Avon%'
  AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT c."name"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "foreign_data" fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE fd."language" = 'Japanese'
ORDER BY c."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."originaltype" = 'Summon - Angel'
  AND c."subtypes" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."subtypes" <> ''
  AND c."subtypes" NOT LIKE '%Angel%';

SELECT
    "id",
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS "count"
FROM "cards" AS c
WHERE c."bordercolor" = 'black'
ORDER BY c."id" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT DISTINCT c."name"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE (c."power" IS NULL OR c."power" = '*')
  AND c."promotypes" LIKE '%arenaleague%'
ORDER BY c."name" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    fd."language",
    fd."flavortext",
    c."type"
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."watermark" = 'colorpie'

SELECT c."convertedmanacost"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."name" LIKE 'Ancestor%Chosen'

SELECT s."id"
FROM "sets" AS s
ORDER BY s."basesetsize"::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."artist" LIKE '%Aaron Miller%'
  AND c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL;

WITH oldest_mythic AS (
    SELECT
        c."name",
        c."originalreleasedate",
        c."uuid"
    FROM "cards" c
    WHERE c."rarity" = 'mythic'
      AND c."originalreleasedate" IS NOT NULL
      AND c."originalreleasedate" <> ''
    ORDER BY c."originalreleasedate" ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    om."originalreleasedate",
    l."format"
FROM oldest_mythic om
JOIN "legalities" l
    ON l."uuid" = om."uuid"
WHERE LOWER(l."status") = 'legal'
ORDER BY l."format" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT DISTINCT st."translation"
FROM "foreign_data" fd
JOIN "cards" c ON c."uuid" = fd."uuid"
JOIN "set_translations" st ON st."setcode" = c."setcode"
WHERE fd."name" LIKE '%Tendo Ice Bridge%'
  AND st."language" = 'French';

SELECT
    ROUND(
        COUNT(CASE WHEN s."type" = 'expansion' THEN 1 END)::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM "set_translations" st
JOIN "sets" s ON s."code" = st."setcode"
WHERE st."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT DISTINCT
    l."status"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l
    ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."types" LIKE '%Artifact%'
  AND c."side" IS NULL
  AND l."format" = 'vintage';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."uuid") AS card_count
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l
  ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
JOIN "rulings" r
  ON r."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE l."format" = 'premodern'
  AND r."text" = 'This is a triggered mana ability.'
  AND c."side" IS NULL;

SELECT
    c."id",
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c."isstoryspotlight" = 1 AND c."istextless" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::NUMERIC,
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."isstoryspotlight" = 1
  AND c."istextless" = 0
GROUP BY c."id"
ORDER BY c."id" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."code") AS "set_count"
FROM "sets" s
JOIN "set_translations" st
  ON st."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE st."language" = 'Japanese'
  AND (s."mtgocode" IS NULL OR s."mtgocode" = '');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."uuid") AS "count"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%Abundance%'
  AND c."rarity" = 'rare'
  AND c."types" LIKE '%Enchantment%'
  AND l."status" = 'Legal'
  
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "legalities" l2
    WHERE l2."uuid" = c."uuid"
      AND l2."status" <> 'Legal'
  );

SELECT
    c."id",
    c."hascontentwarning",
    r."text"
FROM "cards" c
LEFT JOIN "rulings" r
    ON r."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."artist" LIKE '%Stephen Daniel%'

SELECT DISTINCT
    s."name" AS set_name,
    s."mtgocode" AS mtgo_code
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s
    ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%Angel of Mercy%'
  AND s."mtgocode" IS NOT NULL
  AND s."mtgocode" <> ''

SELECT s."id"
FROM "sets" s
WHERE s."type" = 'commander'
ORDER BY s."totalsetsize"::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    c."name" AS card_name,
    r."text" AS ruling_text,
    c."hascontentwarning" AS has_content_warning
FROM "cards" c
LEFT JOIN "rulings" r
    ON r."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."artist" LIKE '%Jim Pavelec%'
ORDER BY c."name" ASC NULLS FIRST, r."text" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT DISTINCT
    c."name"   AS card_name,
    l."format" AS format
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s
    ON c."setcode" = s."code"
JOIN "legalities" l
    ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE s."name" = 'Hour of Devastation'
  AND l."status" = 'Legal'
ORDER BY c."name" ASC NULLS FIRST, l."format" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN c."hascontentwarning" = '0' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(c."id")::NUMERIC,
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l
    ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE l."format" = 'commander'
  AND l."status" = 'Legal';

SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN c."isnonfoilonly" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fd."language" = 'Japanese' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "foreign_data" fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE fd."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd."language" = 'French' THEN c."uuid" END)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c."uuid"), 0)::NUMERIC,
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
LEFT JOIN "foreign_data" fd
    ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."power" IS NULL OR c."power" = '*';

SELECT DISTINCT s."id"
FROM "sets" s
JOIN "cards" c ON c."setcode" = s."code"
JOIN "foreign_data" fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE s."isforeignonly" = 1
  AND s."isfoilonly" = 1
  AND fd."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd."language" = 'French' THEN c."id" END)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c."id"), 0)::NUMERIC,
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "foreign_data" fd
    ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."isstoryspotlight" = 1;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL
                 AND c."cardkingdomfoilid" <> ''
                 AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL
                 AND c."cardkingdomid" <> ''
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
        )::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE s."name" LIKE '%Coldsnap%';

SELECT DISTINCT c."artist"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE s."name" LIKE '%Coldsnap%'
  AND c."artist" IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy')
ORDER BY c."artist" ASC NULLS FIRST;

  AND s."fundingtype" = 'Directly funded';

WITH rates AS (
    SELECT
        s."cds",
        s."numge1500"::numeric / NULLIF(s."numtsttakr"::numeric, 0) AS excellence_rate
    FROM "satscores" s
    WHERE s."numtsttakr" IS NOT NULL
      AND s."numtsttakr"::numeric > 0
)

SELECT sch."phone"
FROM rates r
JOIN "schools" sch ON sch."cdscode" = r."cds"
ORDER BY r.excellence_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3

SELECT
    s."school" AS school_name,
    sc."charternum" AS charter_number,
    sc."avgscrwrite" AS avg_writing_score
FROM "satscores" sc
JOIN "schools" s
    ON s."cdscode" = sc."cds"
WHERE sc."avgscrwrite"::numeric > 499
  AND sc."charternum" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sc."avgscrwrite"::numeric DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT ss."cds", ss."sname", ss."avgscrread"
    FROM "satscores" ss
    ORDER BY ss."avgscrread" DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM "frpm" f
JOIN "schools" s ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
JOIN top_school ts ON ts."cds" = s."cdscode"

WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT "admfname1" AS fname, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname1" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS fname, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname2" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS fname, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname3" <> ''
)
SELECT
    "fname",
    "district",
    COUNT(*) AS name_count
FROM admin_names
GROUP BY "fname", "district"
ORDER BY name_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 2;

SELECT
    f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" AS frpm_count_ages_5_17
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.school = 'Youth Authority School'
  AND s.mailstreet = 'PO Box 1040';

SELECT
    s."school" AS school_name,
    s."ncesschool" AS nces_school_id,
    f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_ages_5_17
FROM "frpm" f
JOIN "schools" s
    ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(ss."numtsttakr") AS avg_test_takers
FROM "satscores" ss
JOIN "schools" s ON s."cdscode" = ss."cds"
WHERE s."city" = 'Fresno'

SELECT s."gsoffered"
FROM "schools" s

ORDER BY CAST(s."longitude" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s."sname" AS school_name,
        s."avgscrmath" AS math_avg,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s."avgscrmath" DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
    FROM "satscores" s
    WHERE s."avgscrmath" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    sc."school" AS school_name,
    sc."mailstreet" AS postal_street_address
FROM ranked r
JOIN "schools" sc
    ON sc."school" = r.school_name
WHERE r.rn = 7

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s."cds" AS cds,
        s."avgscrwrite" AS avgscrwrite,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk
    FROM "satscores" s
    WHERE s."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    sch."phone",
    sch."ext"
FROM ranked r
JOIN "schools" sch
    ON sch."cdscode" = r.cds
WHERE r.rnk = 333;

WITH school_totals AS (
    SELECT
        s."cds",
        s."sname",
        s."avgscrmath",
        (s."avgscrmath" + s."avgscrread" + s."avgscrwrite") AS total_score
    FROM "satscores" s
    WHERE s."avgscrmath" IS NOT NULL
      AND s."avgscrread" IS NOT NULL
      AND s."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    st."avgscrmath" AS average_math_score,
    sc."county"
FROM school_totals st
JOIN "schools" sc
    ON sc."cdscode" = st."cds"
ORDER BY st."total_score" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    s."street",
    s."city",
    s."zip",
    s."state"
FROM "satscores" AS sat
JOIN "schools" AS s
    ON s."cdscode" = sat."cds"

  AND sat."numtsttakr" <> '0'
  AND sat."numge1500" IS NOT NULL

    sat."avgscrwrite" AS avg_writing_score,
